title: Following a route: states
subtitle: On screen only: no service, no background location. Positions and progress stay in memory; nothing is saved, logged or sent by itself (P012c2a and b, ADR 0022). Every state inside Following returns to On the route

nodes.label: Routes in the sheet, one selected (its card, or a tap on its line). From a start chosen in search: Preview only
Start (from the user's location only): precise permission and a position from the last 10 s?
Says what is missing; offers the existing permission flows
On the route: camera follows, distance and time left
No position for 10 s: Searching for GPS, until a new position
Over max(50 m, 2 x accuracy) away for 10 s: off the route, until back near the line
Recalculate (tap only): one request, 20 s limit. New route: following goes on. Failed: says why
App off screen: paused, no positions read. Returning continues, with a note once
Back or End: End navigation? Cancel keeps following
Within max(30 m, accuracy) of the end: You've arrived, Done
Back to the routes (also when the permission or precise location is lost)
